Pass your way if you are looking for a proper dinner.
Aug 2024 • Couples
Imagine stranding in this bar at 9:30 p.m., the only restaurant where service has not yet ended. The music is already very loud and while you have been sitting for less than a minute, the waiters come to ask you every 30 seconds for your order. You choose a pad thai and a chicken burger. After about ten minutes punctuated by the deafening sounds of helium balloons filled for tourists at the bar, the dishes arrive. The pad thai is bland but correct, although the chicken is a strange consistency. The chicken burger, on the other hand, is a disaster. Two pieces of bread quite dry and soaked in a bad ketchup, an elastic and tasteless chicken “steak” covered with fat and tasteless “cheese” all resting on a leaf of salad with wilted edges of an inordinate size and one, one, slice of tomato. In desperation, you turn to fries. Little salty, without real consistency, you regret McDonalds, that is. You are completely deafened by the music and howls of tourists. The light is out, you understand that you don’t have to do anything there. You leave this deplored establishment and regret having made the mistake of entering.
